μνάς.m: sum of money equivalent to a hundred drachmas

n: Mnevis, a bull-shaped aspect of the god Atum-Ra venerated in Heliopolis
(Greek mythology) Mnemosyne, mother of the Muses
Mnesalces, an Armenian man mentioned by Plutarch
(Greek mythology) Mnesus, a Paeonian slain by Achilles

μνήστρια.m: a woman who woos or courts for another, a match-maker
